why: Value regression is back on (journal, ci-10). ci-9 parked it when the same learner went 0 of 400 against Greedy on content whose three starting spells left nothing to choose between; on 7e199df4 it reads 43.5%, and the clone 32.0%. Note what did not improve: r2 is -0.2876 against a baselineR2 of 0.1355, worse than the 0.2225/0.2815 that ci-9 read the stop off. A policy only has to rank the actions of one position and r2 scores absolute prediction, so it was never the instrument -- watch the win rates against Greedy and Random, not the fit. Exploration is on because the value policy cannot compare moves it never saw Greedy refuse (ADR 0014): ci-10 fitted 600 action keys off the explored dataset against the clone's 202 off pure self-play. Open: value beats Random only 67.8% where Greedy beats it 97.8%, so it is much the weaker agent and still nearly even against Greedy -- and it drags 27% of those matches to the round cap, where it loses 80 and wins 7.
